pages.text: $(#9370DB)🌌 Void Whispers · Cosmic Nectar 🌀$()$(br2)$(l)$(#4B0082)「Drink the galaxy within your cup, let the Ender Eye shimmer for you」$()$(br)$(#DAA520)Amber honey$() merges into the soft glow of $(#B0B0B0)moon milk$(), while $(#800080)Chorus fruit essence$() and $(#BA55D3)Perilla petals$() resonate within $(#483D8B)void ripples$()—a transcendent elixir that lets $(l)flesh synchronize with the orbits of the stars$().

$(#4B0082)▌ Void Duality $()$(br2)$(l)$(#4169E1)👁 Star Insight$()$(br)Even the faintest $(#000000)void dust$() particles become $(#9370DB)clearly visible$().$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)💫 Star Core Pulse$()$(br)During wound healing, $(#FF0000)rose nebula$()-shaped luminescent patterns appear.

$(br2)$(#800080)▌ Interstellar Ritual $()$(br)- Use a $(#483D8B)End Stone Mortar$() to grind $(#BA55D3)Perilla flowers$() into $(#E6E6FA)stardust powder$().$(br)- $(#800080)Chorus fruit$() must be soaked in $(#DAA520)honey$() until it displays $(#9370DB)a mysterious entangled glow$().$(br)- When adding $(#B0B0B0)cream$(), be cautious of potential $(#4B0082)spatial distortions$().$(br2)$(#ADD8E6)※$() A successful brew will form a $(#00BFFF)galactic vortex$() on the liquid’s surface.

$(br2)$(#483D8B)『 Chronicles of the Starsea 』$()$(br)An inscription recorded by the Ender Elders:$(br)'When $(#BA55D3)Perilla petals$() bloom within the $(#DAA520)honey sea$(),$(br)the drinker shall gain eyes like those of the $(#4169E1)Ender Dragon$(),$(br)peering into darkness itself, while$(br)$(#FF69B4)wounds$() will heal with radiant $(#FF0000)stellar bursts$()—$(br)a tribute from the $(#9370DB)lost stars$() to $(#4B0082)unyielding life$().'
